ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; surface is dominated by low-intensity pixels (>95% dark) with high-intensity pixels limited to specular highlights from water surface tension.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-intensity pigmentation across the entire visible surface; no contiguous geometric white blobs, mottling, or banding are detectable.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an acute angle at the vertex and a significant bounding-box depth relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; pixel-amplitude variations are most pronounced on the distal portions of both lobes with jagged, non-uniform peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep originating from the peduncle transition into a predominantly convex trajectory toward the distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular jaggedness and potential tissue loss on the far-left distal trailing edge, appearing as a more severe indentation than the standard serration pattern.
